column3: Restates eating Allah-given halal, good provision and joining it to gratitude and exclusive worship.

Shows good provision received with divine rescue should issue in gratitude.
Pairs eating good provision with a warning against transgression in it.

Makes worship of Allah and gratitude its explicit paired response.
Forbids declaring Allah's good things forbidden and prohibits excess.
Uses eating figuratively for the consequence of concealing revelation, not lawful provision.
